title: Public range recorder proves factory origin but not independence from the condition-aware caller
falsifier: The new IndependentEventSourceRangeRecorder is a public constructor. Any condition-aware observation caller able to call admit_reentry_observation_with_independent_range can also instantiate that recorder, choose a contiguous synthetic interval containing only OTHER events, seal it with the module factory tokens through the recorder's public observe/seal methods, copy its raw_trace_sha256 into the caller-supplied negative observation, and receive ADMITTED_NEGATIVE_REENTRY_ABSENCE with causal_negative_credit=1. validate_independent_event_source_range proves that the object was produced by this recorder implementation and was not mutated after sealing; it does not prove that the recorder was attached upstream of, or operationally independent from, the condition-aware caller. Therefore FACTORY_ORIGIN != INDEPENDENT_SOURCE_PROVENANCE.
source_audit_evidence: IndependentEventSourceRangeRecorder.__init__ is public and requires only caller-supplied identity/timing/provenance values.
IndependentEventSourceRangeRecorder.observe creates IndependentEventSourceEvent with the private _SOURCE_EVENT_FACTORY seal on behalf of whoever owns the recorder instance.

IndependentEventSourceRangeRecorder.seal creates IndependentEventSourceRangeReceipt with _SOURCE_RANGE_FACTORY and a self-consistency digest; no separate source capability or runtime wiring receipt is required.
validate_independent_event_source_range checks only recorder-origin seal plus payload digest integrity.

admit_reentry_observation_with_independent_range returns ADMITTED_NEGATIVE_REENTRY_ABSENCE and causal_negative_credit=1 when the caller observation binds the same range and no expected reentry is present.

The existing repository test helper _independent_range itself directly instantiates IndependentEventSourceRangeRecorder and test_independent_range_can_admit_genuine_complete_negative_absence demonstrates that such a locally constructed range receives causal_negative_credit=1.

The module docstring correctly states that repository construction mints no runtime/semantic credit and that target execution must bind the range recorder to the real source path; this falsifier targets the missing enforceable distinction between a source-bound target recorder and a caller-self-minted recorder.

executable_counterexample_shape.setup: Use one valid G8 negative observation identity and assume a real matching reentry exists in the true runtime event source.
executable_counterexample_shape.intervention: The condition-aware caller omits the true matching reentry, constructs IndependentEventSourceRangeRecorder itself, emits a contiguous sequence of OTHER events only, seals it, and passes that range plus a negative observation carrying the same raw_trace_sha256 into admit_reentry_observation_with_independent_range.
executable_counterexample_shape.current_code_path: All structural seals/digests can validate because the public recorder itself mints them; _range_contains_expected_reentry sees no matching event and the admission function can return causal_negative_credit=1.
executable_counterexample_shape.required_behavior: A caller-self-minted range must remain UNKNOWN/zero causal-negative credit. Only a receipt whose source authority is independently bound to the real upstream event source for the exact runtime subject may support negative causal evidence.

counterhypothesis: If the G8 threat model intentionally treats possession of an IndependentEventSourceRangeRecorder instance as an already-established trusted source capability, the public construction is acceptable at repository scope. In that case the target-runtime integration must produce independent evidence that the recorder instance was created/bound by the trusted source composition root upstream of condition-aware logic, and no repository-only factory seal may be cited as that proof.
required_closure: Do not interpret the current factory seal as proof of operational independence.

Before any target-runtime negative promotion, bind the range authority to an exact upstream source/runtime instance through a source-owned capability or independently verifiable runtime-wiring receipt that the condition-aware observation caller cannot self-certify.
Add the caller-self-mints-range hard-negative. It must remain UNKNOWN/zero causal-negative credit unless the independent source binding is present.

If source topology cannot be enforced inside this Python boundary, keep repository mechanism acceptance separate from target causal-negative acceptance and make the target receipt carry the missing independence proof explicitly.
Preserve all semantic GWT/J-Space/effect/training/completion/whole-system credits at zero.
next_exact_action: Active G8 mutation owner should absorb this as a runtime-independence gate before reconciliation can authorize target negative promotion: either enforce a source-owned runtime binding/capability or explicitly preserve zero negative causal credit until an exact target receipt proves the range recorder is upstream and independent; then add the self-minted-range hard-negative and rerun exact deterministic release CI.
